sentences.text:
The learned counsels for the respondents submit that the Impugned Direction has been issued by exercising powers under Section 16(5) read with Section 92(2)(g) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (hereinafter referred to as "Act").
4.
I have considered the submissions made by the learned counsels for the respondents.

Admittedly,
the Regulations in force since 2011 allowed blending of mustard oil with other edible oil upto 20%.

The Impugned Order records that the respondents are in the process of amending the 2011 Regulations and the Draft Food Safety and Standards (Prohibition and Restriction on Sales)
Amendment Regulations, 2020 have been framed.

Amendment Regulations, 2020
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The respondents shall, therefore, file an affidavit disclosing the urgency for issuance of the Impugned Direction.

In this regard, notice may be made to Section 18(2)(d) of the Act which reads as under:-
"18.
General principles to be followed in Administration of the Act.

xxxxxxx (2) The Food Authority shall, while framing regulations or specifying standards under this Act- xxxxxx (d) ensure that there is open and transparent public consultation, directly or through representative bodies including all levels of panchayats, during the preparation, evaluation and revision of regulations, except where it is of opinion that there is an urgency concerning food safety or public health to make or amend the regulations in which case such consultation may be dispend with:
Provided that such regulations shall be in force for not more than six months;"
5. A reading of the above shows that the Regulations and Standards have to be fixed in an open and transparent public consultation process.

Such process can be bypassed only where an opinion is Kanchan Oil Industries Ltd vs Union Of India & Anr on 1 October, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/114453237/
2 formed that there is an urgency concerning food safety or public health.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The respondents shall,
therefore, explain on affidavit the urgency which persuaded them to issue the Impugned Direction without following the consultative process as mandated in Section 18(2)(d) of the Act.
Such affidavit be filed within a period of one week.
Reply thereto be filed by the petitioners within a period of one week thereafter.

6. List on 22nd October, 2020.
7.
As the learned counsel for the petitioner in WP (C) 7217/2020 is also present in this hearing, the date in the said petition is also preponed to 22.10.2020.
The Registry shall take note of the same.
8. In the meantime, the operation of the Impugned Direction dated 23.09.2020 and the consequent direction dated 25.09.2020 shall remain stayed.
9. A copy of this order be supplied to the learned counsels for the parties on the e-mail address provided.
NAVIN CHAWLA, J OCTOBER 1, 2020/
